messages.text: We have agreement on the actual operation. I accept the civilian accounting, and I am not asking for a Campaign without passage. Keep this bargain in mind when we discuss authority: the Janissariat supplied both assets and accepted a lawful order while your commercial voyage continued. That service deserves recognition as competence, not an argument for perpetual subordination.

Your confirmation of the lodged reserve and Relief directive answers my outstanding concern. Record Raid and the separate Warrant. I will defend this operation to my colleague because it gives Spear a credible fight without abandoning the settlements.

reason: The promised supporting orders are now explicit. I retain Raid as the strongest funded use of our offered cohort; constitutional preferences remain open for the later discussion.
